source.go_inbound_response_test: conduit/llm/transformer/openai/audio_inbound_test.go::TestAudioInboundTransformer_Transcription (subtest 'response raw verbose_json passthrough keeps extra fields' L268-276, asserting raw-body passthrough when Transcription.Raw is set)
source.note: Response path for POST /v1/audio/transcriptions with response_format json. The upstream body {"text":"hello world"} is the verbatim Go literal. The outbound test asserts the unified llm.Response preserves both the parsed Text and the raw body (Raw==body, RawContentType=='application/json') for lossless passthrough. The client_http section is COMPOSED from two Go assertions with different fixtures: the outbound 'json' subtest pins Raw for this body, and the inbound passthrough subtest pins that a set Raw is returned verbatim as the client body — no single Go test chains this exact fixture end-to-end. llm.TranscriptionResponse.Raw/RawContentType are json:"-" fields, so they do not appear in the serialized unified_response; they are documented in the comment instead. inbound_http, unified_request, selected_channel and outbound_http are null (request stages not exercised by these tests; the transcription request wire body is multipart/form-data with a generated boundary and is not representable as a byte-stable golden body).

upstream_http._comment: httpclient.Response from the outbound 'json' subtest: StatusCode 200, Content-Type application/json, Request.APIFormat 'openai/audio_transcriptions' (dispatch key), Body = verbatim literal below.

unified_response._comment: Extension field recording the llm.Response produced by the outbound transformer. Byte-asserted: Transcription.Text=='hello world', Transcription.Raw==<upstream body bytes>, Transcription.RawContentType=='application/json'. Raw/RawContentType are json:"-" (not serialized); only the modeled fields appear below.

client_http._comment: Expected client HTTP response when the inbound transcription transformer serves a unified response whose Raw is set: audio_inbound.go TransformResponse (L259-273) returns StatusCode 200 with Body==Raw and Content-Type==RawContentType. The passthrough behavior is byte-asserted by the inbound subtest 'response raw verbose_json passthrough keeps extra fields' (with its own fixture); applying it to THIS fixture's Raw deterministically yields the body below.
